scope_note: G2a is the first of four G2 sub-gates. It does NOT close G2; see CHECKLIST.
target: OpenFL HTML5 in a fresh real-browser tab; SWFs fetched over HTTP, never from a local path

http_fetch.same_origin_rationale: a second port would fail on CORS as an artefact of the rig, not the client
http_fetch.timing_note: aggregate across the five parsed canaries, cold then browser-cached

proved.contract: straight (un-premultiplied) RGBA8888 and raw binary blobs, compared by SHA-256 against an independent Python/PIL decoder
proved.checksumless_cws: elephants.swf inflates without an Adler-32 trailer and is accepted only after its length matches the SWF header exactly

deferred.G2b: PNG/JPEG bitmap payloads decoded through the browser
deferred.G2c: ZWS/LZMA container - three canaries deferred, asserted as exactly three
deferred.G2e: parity against the Flash client itself, not just a second independent decoder

corpus_finding.summary: the SWF JPEG-family tags are containers, not a codec
corpus_finding.consequence: decoder scope is zlib + JPEG + PNG, chosen per character by payload magic; PLAN/CHECKLIST previously said two decoder families

reference_correction.finding: the first reference decoder forced every JPEG-tag payload to RGB and set alpha 255
reference_correction.effect: would have silently dropped the alpha channel of all 1,468 PNG-in-JPEG2 characters
reference_correction.resolution: detect payload magic; PNG/GIF keep their own alpha and ignore the JPEG3 alpha block

commands: fresh browser-tab check of DOM markers, console marker, and console errors
